text: The perfect light-weight blanket. This blanket is super soft, fuzzy and comfy. The light weight material makes it perfect for most seasons. It’s great!

product_metadata.title: Bare Home Fleece Blanket - Twin/Twin Extra Long Blanket - Grey - Lightweight Blanket for Bed, Sofa, Couch, Camping, and Travel - Microplush - Ultra Soft Warm Blanket (Twin/Twin XL, Grey)
features: ALL-AROUND COMFORT: Contains 1 Twin/Twin XL Size Microplush Flannel Fleece Blanket (66" x 90"). Made from premium microfleece yarns, Bare Home Microplush Fleece Blanket has a heavier weight than a typical flannel blanket at 300 GSM. The plush two-sided pile means that it is thicker and warmer than traditional fleece or cotton. This blanket has a soft, velvety feel for excellent comfort and warmth.

PREMIUM FABRIC: Microfiber is thicker and not as heavy as cotton, and will keep you warm in all seasons. This lightweight blanket has all of the warmth of wool without the scratchiness. Sleep on our plush fleece blanket for 30 nights. If you are still not satisfied, contact our live customer service team and we'll make it right.

PLUSH YET DURABLE DESIGN: Our Microplush Blanket is made from 100% polyester microfiber yarn which are both strong and durable. This warm and cozy fabric also has anti-pilling properties and will not shed. Double needle cover stitches create strong seams along the 1-inch hem.

MULTI-PURPOSE: Bare Home Microplush Fleece Blanket is a versatile option with 4 sizes and 24 colors to suit your decor. Use this classic throw blanket as an extra layer on your bed for ultimate warmth and comfort while you sleep. Snuggle up under this super cozy blanket on the couch, or while winter camping.
EASY CARE: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach, dry clean, or iron.
